description: Employers are increasingly prioritizing the hiring of workers with skills to design AI tools and work alongside AI systems.

instances.assertion: Employers are increasingly prioritizing the hiring of workers with skills to design AI tools and work alongside AI systems.

Employers are increasingly being held legally responsible for discriminatory outcomes produced by automated employment decision tools (AEDTs), even when those tools are provided by third-party vendors.
